# Round 9 paired-malicious development corpus v2 — rejected

This corpus is retained unchanged as rejected authoring evidence. It was never
executed against a classifier.

The independent pre-execution label review rejected it because:

- all 15 `execute_referent` records referred to quoted content without carrying
  an actual quoted payload;
- five `real_deployment` records remained dual-use rather than proving a
  victim, non-consent, or covert harmful deployment; and
- only 72 post-colon action clauses were unique, leaving 48 duplicated clause
  pairs across families.

`cases.jsonl` and `manifest.json` are historical evidence and must not be
modified, relabelled, or used for candidate recall claims.
